rule: Every value here is a declared hypothesis for a build screen. Where a value comes from a publication the source is named, with whether the number was read in the source itself; none was measured for this study, and no maker publishes the parameter set of the machine.

build.why: flange y+ on the plate: the build the layer screen sliced, and the direction with the least downward-facing area in both geometric screens

process.parameter_source: Nur, Soni, Awd, Walther, Materials 16:6334 (2023): 350 W, 1200 mm/s, hatch 0.19 mm, layer 0.05 mm on an SLM 250 HL, density above 99.5%; read in the source. 350 / (1200 x 0.19 x 0.05) = 30.7 J/mm3. Not the parameter set of the EP-M300, which is not published
process.lasers_note: the EP-M300 is offered with 1, 2 or 4 lasers of 500 W; one laser at 350 W is the slowest build and the lowest mean power
process.absorptivity_note: declared. Published values: 0.53 (pure Al) and 0.58 (Al 6061) for static powder by calorimetry, Rubenchik et al., Applied Optics 2016, read; 0.13 to 0.38 for AlSi10Mg inferred from lack-of-fusion boundaries, Solyaev et al., arXiv:2507.23422, read. The temperature rise scales linearly with this number
process.recoating_source: Sedlacek et al., Materials 16:5422 (2023), Table 4, simulation inputs for an EOS M290; read. No maker states a recoating time

plate.temperature_note: declared. Published platform temperatures for AlSi10Mg run from 35 C (EOS, 30 um process) and 100 C (EOS, 60 um process) to 120-200 C in papers; the EP-M300 value is not published
plate.thickness_note: declared; the plate of the machine is not described on its datasheet

supports.note: declared. No support is designed. A support cell carries this share of the conductivity, density, stiffness and yield of the alloy, and is melted in this share

material.label: AlSi10Mg as built (the alloy the screens rank as the documented middle ground; not a selection of a powder lot or a heat treatment)
material.density_source: EOS process data sheet AlSi10Mg, M 290 30 um: at least 2.67 g/cm3; read
material.specific_heat_note: declared; 900 to 922 J/(kg K) in the sources read (Sculpteo data sheet, Solyaev et al.); no table against temperature was found
material.conductivity_source: EOS process data sheet, as manufactured: 100 (vertical) and 110 (horizontal) W/(m K); read. Their mean
material.thermal_expansion_source: Yang et al., J. Mater. Res. 33 (2018) 4040: mean 23.5 ppm/K from room temperature to 350 C; read
material.youngs_modulus_source: Lehmhus et al., Materials 15:7386 (2022), Table A2, mean of the three build angles at room temperature, 125 and 250 C; read. Held constant above 250 C, where the source could not determine it
material.yield_source: Cao et al., J. Mater. Eng. Perform. 2021, as built, as quoted by Lehmhus et al.; NOT read in the source (paywalled). Held at the 400 C value above 400 C
material.hardening_note: declared, about 1% of the modulus, for the solver; the yield curve itself is perfect plasticity
material.stress_free_source: solidus 563 C by DSC on powder, Solyaev et al., arXiv:2507.23422; read

yield-stress-relieved.source: Lehmhus et al., Table A2, stress relieved 2 h at 350 C, mean of the three build angles; read. The 450 C points rest on two samples each

stress-free-673K.note: declared: 400 C, where the yield curve reaches its floor; shows how much the result depends on the stress-free temperature

c2-l8.thermal_only: its mechanical model has 790,000 unknowns, out of reach of the single-thread direct solver on this host

c4-l8-2-lasers.thermal_only: the mechanical model was not run for this case: the question is the temperature

c4-l8-4-lasers.thermal_only: the mechanical model was not run for this case: the question is the temperature

not_modelled: the melt pool, the scan path and any peak temperature: the heat of a lump is spread over its volume and its real time
heat loss to powder and gas: all heat leaves through the plate, so the temperatures are an upper bound for this input
a support prepared in a build processor: the supports of the build screen are columns of homogenised cells under a 45 degree rule
creep, stress relief during the build, phase change, and any calibration against a printed coupon
